scripts.text:
[Guard]
People under ^ff0000level 130^000000
cannot enter this place.
This place is dangerous. Please go back.
scripts.translation:
[卫兵]
^ff0000130级^000000以下的玩家
无法进入此地。
这里很危险，请回去吧。

scripts.text:
[Guard]
Buwaya is dangerous.
Please come back after you form a
team with other people.
scripts.translation:
[卫兵]
宝箱巨鳄很危险。
请与其他人组队后再来。

scripts.text:
[Guard]
This place is dangerous. Please go back.
If you dont have any business here, please go back.
scripts.translation:
[卫兵]
这里很危险，请回去吧。
如果您没有要事，请离开。

scripts.text: Why is it so dangerous?
scripts.translation: 为什么这么危险？

scripts.text: I'm here to hunt down Buwaya.
scripts.translation: 我来讨伐宝箱巨鳄。

scripts.text: End conversation.
scripts.translation: 结束对话

scripts.text:
[Guard]
Recently, there has been a case
where villagers have disappeared.
After investigating the tracks, 
we found out the giant monster Buwaya
was responsible.
scripts.translation:
[卫兵]
最近发生了村民失踪的事件。
经过调查足迹，
我们发现是巨大的魔物宝箱巨鳄
所为。

scripts.text:
[Guard]
Soldiers and mercenaries have been dispatched to 
hunt down Buwaya, but were never
completely successful.
scripts.translation:
[卫兵]
士兵和雇佣兵已被派去
讨伐宝箱巨鳄，但从未
完全成功。

scripts.text:
[Guard]
Buwaya is still kidnapping
the villagers to this day.
Please gather some people to get rid of Buwaya.
scripts.translation:
[卫兵]
宝箱巨鳄至今仍在绑架
村民。
请召集一些人来消灭宝箱巨鳄。

scripts.text:
[Guard]
Buwaya is still hiding.
Even if you enter now, Buwaya will not come out. 
Please come back later.
scripts.translation:
[卫兵]
宝箱巨鳄还在躲藏。
现在进去，宝箱巨鳄也不会出来。
请稍后再来。

scripts.text:
[Guard]
Party name is... {0}.
Party leader is... {1}
^0000ff{2}^000000 cannot be opened now.
Please try a moment later.
scripts.translation:
[卫兵]
队伍名称是... {0}。
队伍首领是... {1}
^0000ff{2}^000000现在无法开启。
请稍后再试。

scripts.text:
[Guard]
I will open up the tunnel to ^0000ff{0}^000000.
I wish you good luck.
scripts.translation:
[卫兵]
我将为^0000ff{0}^000000开启隧道。
祝你们好运。

scripts.text:
[Guard]
This place is dangerous. You cannot enter.
scripts.translation:
[卫兵]
这里很危险，您无法进入。

scripts.text:
[Guard]
Let me talk with the party leader.
Please call forth the leader.
scripts.translation:
[卫兵]
让我与队伍首领谈谈。
请召唤首领。

scripts.text:
[Guard]
People under ^ff0000level 130^000000
cannot enter this place.
This place is dangerous. Please go back.
scripts.translation:
[卫兵]
^ff0000130级^000000以下的玩家
无法进入此地。
这里很危险，请回去吧。

scripts.text:
[Guard]
Buwaya is still hiding.
Even if you enter now, Buwaya will not come out.
Please come back later.
scripts.translation:
[卫兵]
宝箱巨鳄还在躲藏。
现在进去，宝箱巨鳄也不会出来。
请稍后再来。

scripts.text: Enter.
scripts.translation: 进入

scripts.text: Turn back.
scripts.translation: 转身离开

scripts.text:
[Guard]
Oh, now is not a good time.
Please try again a moment later.
scripts.translation:
[卫兵]
哦，现在不是好时机。
请稍后再试。

scripts.text:
[Guard]
This place is dangerous. Please do not enter.
scripts.translation:
[卫兵]
这里很危险，请勿进入。

scripts.text: - Could not enter due to an unidentified force. -
scripts.translation: - 由于不明力量，无法进入。 -

scripts.text:
[Guard]
You must value your life.
It is better to think carefully before you act.
scripts.translation:
[卫兵]
您必须珍视生命。
行动前最好三思而后行。

scripts.text:
[Kidnapped Residents]
Buwaya was running around,
and new people got caught.
We will be stuck in here for the rest of our lives.
scripts.translation:
[被绑架的居民]
宝箱巨鳄四处游荡，
又有新的人被抓了。
我们要被困在这里一辈子了。

scripts.text: Get me outta here!!
scripts.translation: 快放我出去！！

scripts.text: Ca...can't escape?
scripts.translation: 难...难道逃不出去吗？

scripts.text:
[Kidnapped Residents]
We don't have enough power to destroy it but Buwaya has a weakness.
Look at the wall over there.
If you knock there, Buywaya will feel pain and spit you out.
scripts.translation:
[被绑架的居民]
我们没有足够的力量摧毁它，但宝箱巨鳄有一个弱点。
看那边的墙。
如果你敲击那里，宝箱巨鳄会感到疼痛，然后把你吐出来。

scripts.text:
[Kidnapped People]
Somthing is wrong here...
Have you experienced this before?
scripts.translation:
[被绑架的人们]
这里有些不对劲...
你以前经历过这种情况吗？

scripts.text:
[Kidnapped Residents]
Ahaa! I wish I had a little more power...
I know its weakness...
scripts.translation:
[被绑架的居民]
啊哈！要是我再多点力气就好了...
我知道它的弱点...

scripts.text: Tell me.
scripts.translation: 告诉我。

scripts.text: Do you really know?
scripts.translation: 你真的知道吗？

scripts.text:
[Kidnapped Residents]
Are you sure you can do it...?
Ok, listen carefully,
its weakness is...
scripts.translation:
[被绑架的居民]
你确定你能做到吗...？
好，仔细听，
它的弱点是...

scripts.text:
[Kidnapped Residents]
...behind us on the walls.
scripts.translation:
[被绑架的居民]
...在我们身后的墙上。

scripts.text:
[Kidnapped Residents]
WHAT?!
Are you ignoring me
because I'm captured in here?
scripts.translation:
[被绑架的居民]
什么？！
你是在因为我被关在这里
就无视我吗？

scripts.text: Would like to go out?
scripts.translation: 想要出去吗？

scripts.text: Yes!
scripts.translation: 准备好了！

scripts.text: No, I will stay.
scripts.translation: 不，我要留下。
